Lines.02063b64-3b27-ab8d-966d-b10890e5ef24: No doubt the Old Mage will have much to say about your adventures, and you will have much to tell him.
Lines.6d581a8d-dbdd-894c-c615-0f7ef4d8a18d: I may not be able to read your thoughts anymore, but I'm certain I know them -
Lines.6de9aeb0-8e64-8ea5-b7ea-fd7446d1f014: *But the orb is not your only concern.*
Lines.7bcf2e61-493f-1633-29b5-14a677a2e67b: I really thought at this point that you might have let go of that...
Lines.7ca9eedd-2b87-9fdb-e1cb-38f15ca58809: You made your own choices. I merely nudged you in the direction that would result in our greatest chance of success.
Lines.8a473777-b3e4-e096-df21-c4efc37da832: *Your prince has been sacrificed, and you have been abandoned by your queen.*
Lines.516a297e-77ab-7735-6aed-8aa4d185fd8d: Will you return to the Elfsong Tavern with me? I would like to discuss that with you... in detail.
Lines.a9f388cf-2066-6e41-bf91-3a2cf7831380: Strange, isn't it? To have travelled this far, inseparable from one another, only to cut the cord at the final step.
Lines.c845e704-068d-dc6d-efab-d8e652de3f58: *Your prince has been sacrificed, and you have failed your queen.*
Lines.c9a510b8-a954-71d2-fa6a-e379c708ca39: *The threat of the Grand Design is over, but your people will never accept you back into their embrace.*
Lines.e6349c7a-462f-9ba3-c8da-72d5e88246a1: No doubt you will use them to summon the Crown. But what then? What will you do when such power is in your grasp?
Lines.fdd9a221-5538-3e47-dec0-dc2bdfac4fcb: I trust you will enjoy the process, for few will believe the stories you have to tell.
Lines.fe343a58-27c0-49cd-58df-82104d0f21b8: Well-deserved. You will find your dreams much changed, full of colours and shapes you do not yet recognise. But you will know them, in time.
Lines.2d4ab42c-c95d-ae6d-c99f-a3127589ba33: Very well. It is best if we take the sewers... I am too tired to maintain a disguise.
Lines.84ff400d-ec5a-7fcc-6fa1-3049c5bb7265: Not a bad idea - it will certainly be safer than staying in the city.
Lines.6589786f-cddf-61b9-92d3-6609153c3ae7: But I will not be joining you.
Lines.59218e8f-7d77-0a1d-e4ca-3a33c9e12285: You've earned a triumphant homecoming. Though you may find your instincts are somewhat changed - and people will treat you... unkindly.
Lines.0237ff3a-5d3c-e0f7-b3e7-268ccf6fb2d8: *What happens next will be by your design, and yours alone.*
Lines.155444a5-f1d7-9159-dd22-f0c73c1cbf45: *Whatever time is left is yours and yours alone.*
Lines.f9a792ae-8338-2b5d-a79e-8c4de7e7a251: A wise decision, and a humble one.
Lines.18978d67-b14e-6d6b-eeb3-94858942ff51: Perhaps Mystra will even see fit to forgive you for making such a choice, and cure you of the orb.
Lines.1a71ff99-01fd-3a1f-fc4b-2c299515e42d: If you do intend to stay in the city, the Undercellar may offer a suitable refuge while you learn how to hide in plain sight, as I once did.
Lines.1d9ecf10-7852-492c-284c-1976ab2e46d0: For what it's worth, I think you are much improved now.
Lines.ca66aebf-05b7-bdbc-81a2-ab9c4c1dce08: Then keep the stones close. There will be those who seek to take them from you. To stake their claim on power, even though you do not.
Lines.2749736f-3344-9bb1-1421-61c3d06c0f7a: I wish you well, Gale of Waterdeep, for the fate of our world will depend on their failure to find you, or your success in defeating them when they do.
Lines.2e4f79f8-d875-8313-3889-5d79c08c9d42: I will do what I have always done. I will survive.
Lines.ee3586b8-850c-dac3-5808-5972f2fb7a97: This is my city. It needs authority.
Lines.3337aea6-194e-761d-8579-55e7266586bf: But I would not recommend it. The city does not welcome the likes of us, at least not on its surface.
Lines.3974d294-decf-742e-2a82-52d336bd9f93: The expansion of one's mind with the intellect of others' is never a bad idea.
Lines.3a4a46df-b502-cb4a-9f58-225ec207b40e: Embrace your evolution. You are more than you've ever been. All that has changed in you has changed for the better.
Lines.e50cdb86-a9de-55fc-43c6-ee57ceb4faa1: And should our paths ever cross again, I will be glad to see you.
Lines.3e797565-22ff-0270-4889-b7b15747b10b: But I will not be joining you. The city has no love for the likes of me.
Lines.cefd060a-5416-4ad4-18d1-8585a8128dd8: You hold her opinion above mine still? In spite of all she's done to you?
Lines.413e00ed-93d3-991e-a58a-a1ed345aadbe: Then for your sake I hope she shows you mercy. Or that you do to her.
Lines.d96b1742-7405-2c1a-27dc-c706ec5955b0: You're wondering what became of the Netherstones.
Lines.49cbda87-f816-a4e3-7010-b9bd8a04706d: They're lost to the Chionthar, with the Crown. Neither you nor anyone else will ever wield them again.
Lines.73b4322c-6205-e4e3-2e8c-cc0cc1ebb487: So what will you do now, Gale of Waterdeep?
Lines.bfa807dd-1b14-3432-aae5-7cd9de7f75fc: *The orb pulses within you still - Elminster's magic is all that keeps it contained. As long as the magic remains, so do you.*
Lines.f7465c2d-e4c1-c850-5bdd-bb0d5213127d: It's a shame - with an attitude like that, you would have made a wonderful illithid.
Lines.6e621e24-7027-bd8d-7b6e-e20e3727eea6: I must confess, I admire your ambition almost as much as I fear its consequences.
Lines.58ef36ad-66af-f774-738a-8b39efdfe8cd: A word of advice - keep the stones close to you. For as we have seen, even a Netherbrain can be dominated.
Lines.17640b50-e716-407e-afa2-cb80da6a5c4b: What will you do? Now that you have a life of your own to live?
Lines.b2074e4b-e6aa-9e12-8040-b39315f4f37c: *You can make it 'til dawn. If you gather every bit of strength you have, you can survive the night. One last night to say goodbye. One last night to live.*
Lines.d33c2558-fe82-ca03-eeb6-ea4e009d06d8: *You are a mind flayer, the very thing you were taught to hate. Whatever self you still possess is quickly ebbing away.*
Lines.c11c1dfe-d6c5-70ca-0846-9125ed2b6704: Battle forms comrades of the coldest souls, but it seems that yours is determined to stay frozen.
Lines.40cb343e-db74-65a0-e0d8-6eee81ac2ccc: Very well. Then I bid you farewell. And... good luck.
Lines.4a8bf8c3-cdd9-b828-c4c1-e8c7f73dbfef: May your path ahead lead you to the allies you desire.
Lines.acd934af-e2cd-16c2-b091-9f22d771c056: *One last look to remember. One last look to say goodbye.*
